addendum: Wikipedia-led tests, addendum o: a fair check of the Transformer lead of addendum n (Chronos-2 forecasts given to the boosted trees as two extra inputs)
status: Fixed 2026-11-26 12:10 +07:00 (05:10 UTC), before any step of it ran: no control feature built, no model of this record fitted, no subset of months scored, no forecast frozen.
parent_record: prereg/addenda_wiki_led/2026-11-25_n_more_signals_and_models.json and its parents. Rows (1,258,807 scored work-format-months, origins 2019-01 to 2026-07), target D, history, calendar and own-page features, LightGBM settings, walk-forward by test year, five seeds 20261020 to 20261024, change rank, the 2,000 draws of 3-month blocks (rng 20261020), the 14 families of kinds of book, the too-small rule, Benjamini-Hochberg within each comparison and the wording rule are addendum n's (n30_models.py, n50_score.py) unless changed here.
fixed_by: Claude, for Khant Phyo Wai. After the addendum n results Claude asked "Set up a fair, pre-registered check of the Transformer lead?" and Khant answered "Yea" on 26 Nov 2026.
why: In addendum n, HMW14Z (HMW14 plus the Chronos-2 forecasts C2 and C2W as two features) beat HMW14 by +0.0091 (0.0071 to 0.0110) over 2019 to 2026 and +0.0116 over 2024 to 2026, the largest gain of that addendum, but it had no pass rule and no placebo. Two worries remain. (1) Chronos-2 (released 20 Oct 2025) was pretrained on public time series that may cover the test years, so part of its help could come from patterns of those years. (2) Chronos-2 looks at up to 60 months of loans, while the trees' history features reach back about 12 months (h_lt, h_lt1, h_m6, h_m12, h_lyago, h_age), so any longer look at the same loans might help as much; then the gain is about using more history, not about the Transformer.

inputs.Z: feat_Z.parquet of addendum n unchanged: Z_c2 and Z_c2w (median forecast of t+1 minus ln(1 + M6)).
inputs.C_controls: The same monthly ln(1 + loans) series that n40_chronos.py gives Chronos-2 (per work and format; excluded months and months before the first loan missing), at origin t, in plain form: c_y0 to c_y23, the 24 monthly values at t, t-1, ..., t-23; c_mean24, c_mean36, c_mean60, the mean of the available months among the last 24, 36 and 60; c_slope12 and c_slope36, the least-squares slope per month over the available months among the last 12 and 36 (at least 3 months, else missing); c_sd12, the standard deviation over the available months among the last 12 (at least 3); c_zero12, the share of the available months among the last 12 with 0 loans; c_n60, the number of available months among the last 60; and three textbook forecasts of t+1, each as a predicted change (forecast minus ln(1 + M6)): c_ses, simple exponential smoothing over the available months among the last 60 (missing months skipped), started at the first available value, alpha from {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9} with the smallest mean squared one-step error inside the context (ties to the smaller alpha; with fewer than 3 available months the last available value); c_snaive, the value at t-11 (the target's calendar month one year before); c_trend12, the least-squares line over the available months among the last 12 extended to t+1 (at least 3 months). Values that cannot be computed stay missing (LightGBM's default handling).
inputs.Z_lag: Z_c2 and Z_c2w of the same work and format at origin t-12 (dates moved 12 months, as the placebos of addendum n); missing where that row does not exist.

models: LightGBM as addendum n (n30_models.py: 300 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, min_child_samples 50, subsample and colsample 0.8, n_jobs 4), walk-forward by test year 2019 to 2026, five seeds. Stored: HM, HMW14 (addendum l, five seeds) and HMW14Z (addendum n). New: HMW14C = HMW14 + C; HMW14CZ = HMW14 + C + Z; HMW14Z1 = HMW14 + Z_c2; HMW14Z2 = HMW14 + Z_c2w; HMW14Zlag = HMW14 + Z_lag. A refit of HMW14 for the first test year must equal the stored predictions (as n30).

tests.O1_months_Chronos_could_not_have_seen: HMW14Z minus HMW14 change rank on target months 2025-11 to 2026-08 (origins 2025-10 to 2026-07), the 10 scored months after Chronos-2's release on 20 Oct 2025. Five-seed mean; 95% interval and one-sided p from 2,000 draws of 3-month blocks drawn within these 10 months only (circular within them, 4 blocks cut to 10 months, rng 20261126), because draws over all 91 months can miss them.
tests.O2_more_than_a_longer_look_at_the_same_l: HMW14CZ minus HMW14C change rank, all scored months 2019 to 2026, addendum n's draws.
tests.decision: Holm over O1 and O2 at one-sided 0.05; a test passes if it is rejected by Holm, its estimate is above 0 and its 95% interval is above 0. The lead counts as confirmed on past data only if both pass; otherwise the report says which part failed and the gain stays a lead.
tests.O3_blind_month: Frozen forecasts at origin 2026-08 (target 2026-09) for every row of rows.parquet at that origin (the 20,122 rows of addendum l's blind test), from HMW14, HMW14Z, HMW14C and HMW14CZ, each the mean over the five seeds, fitted on every row whose target month is 2026-08 or earlier. Chronos-2 forecasts for these rows are made as in n40_chronos.py (same model, revision, context, covariates). The CSV and its SHA-256 go into prereg/blind_o/ and prereg/README.md and are made public before any month after 2026-08 is downloaded; the script refuses to run if one has been (as l05_freeze.py). Scored once, after addendum l's blind test (l06_score.py) has built the September 2026 world folder, with l06's target loans, excluded-month rule and measures unchanged: change rank within each format over all forecast rows, averaged over the formats, 2,000 bootstrap draws of works (all formats of a drawn work together), seed 20261126. Decision: HMW14Z minus HMW14 and HMW14CZ minus HMW14C, each paired over works, with a 95% interval above 0. One month is a small test and is reported as such. If 2026-09 has been downloaded before the freeze, the blind part moves to origin 2026-09 (target 2026-10), as addendum l's fallback.
tests.descriptive_no_rule: HMW14C minus HMW14 (what the plain controls add); HMW14Z1 minus HMW14 and HMW14Z2 minus HMW14 (which forecast carries the gain); HMW14Z minus HMW14Zlag (dates moved 12 months); HMW14CZ minus HMW14 overall; O1 and O2 by format and for 2024 to 2026; monthly top-20 and early-warning lists; by kind of book: HMW14Z minus HMW14 and HMW14CZ minus HMW14C over the 14 families, Benjamini-Hochberg within each comparison, too-small rule.

order_of_work: 1 this record, fingerprinted and public before any step; 2 control features and Z_lag; 3 models; 4 Chronos-2 for the origin-2026-08 rows and the frozen forecasts; 5 scoring and report; 6 code, frozen forecasts and results in a pull request; 7 later, once September 2026 is downloaded, the blind score. Nothing is rerun after a result except to fix a logged coding error.
seen_before_fixing: All addendum n results, including HMW14Z +0.0091 over 2019 to 2026 and +0.0116 over 2024 to 2026 (the 2024 to 2026 window contains O1's 10 months, so O1 is not blind: it checks the pretraining worry only), Chronos-2 alone 0.307 against 0.347 for HM, and C2W minus C2 +0.0031. Not computed before fixing: any score of O1's 10 months alone, any control feature or model, HMW14Z1, HMW14Z2, HMW14Zlag, any forecast at origin 2026-08 with Z.
known_limits: O1 has 10 months only. O3 has one month. The control set is one fair plain use of the same 60 months, not every possible one. Chronos-2 is used as released, without tuning. Results describe this library and these books.
